==================
String gap followed by ordinary content
==================

#check "first\
  second"

---

(module (check term: (str_lit (escape_sequence))))

==================
Interpolated string gap followed by an expression
==================

#check s!"first\
  {name}"

---

(module (check term: (interpolated_str (escape_sequence) (interpolation (identifier)))))

==================
Ordinary multiline string can contain a blank line
==================

#check "first

second"

---

(module (check term: (str_lit)))

==================
Character literal cannot contain a string gap
:error
==================

#check '\
'

---

==================
String gap cannot contain a blank line
:error
==================

#check "first\

second"

---

==================
Interpolated string gap cannot contain a blank line
:error
==================

#check s!"first\

{name}"

---

==================
Message string gap cannot contain a blank line
:error
==================

#check m!"first\

{name}"

---
